title: Ok. A little thin, not very large
text:
Ok. A little thin, not very large. These racks reminded me a great deal of the old racks I used to have to kerp my 45 records. Yep, I really dated myself on that one. These look to be coated in a silver-toned paint of some type. They did also paint the metal end tips, which is nice - it makes them a little less sharp.

But, that is what these racks looked like - recycled record racks. They don't seem big enough to really hold up cookie sheets properly, but would probably hold baking racks without problems.
